title: Learn How to Dance High Heels in 15 min | Tutorial for Beginners

method.teacher_system: The teacher welcomes beginners, explains that high heels dance focuses on feeling and posture, and introduces five structured moves step-by-step. She breaks down the footwork, hip placement, and upper body posture for each move before combining them into a full choreography combo.
method.signature: Giving detailed posture instructions on how to distribute body weight between hips and ankles during each movement.

practices.what: Teacher breaks down the first move, 'The Walk', into three distinct pieces: step direction, hip switch, and ankle alignment.
Teacher demonstrates 'Hip Slide' by instructing on starting posture, knee bend, and alternating hip lifts.
Teacher teaches 'Hip Deep Slide' by widening stance and shifting all weight deeper onto one side.
Teacher introduces 'Hair Wipe' by combining leg positioning, arm sliding, and head turns.
Teacher breaks down 'Go Down+Switch' focusing on toe direction, knee alignment, and sliding down into a squat.
